questions.question: Can zero training error prove that fitted weights are uniquely determined?
options: Yes, zero error is a unique solution
No; dependent columns can produce many equally good weights
questions.explanation: Independent feature directions determine uniqueness. Extra precision cannot create information missing from the design matrix.
optionFeedback: Dependent columns admit a nonzero null-space direction. Move the weights in that direction and check whether predictions change.
Independent feature directions determine uniqueness. Extra precision cannot create information missing from the design matrix.
Higher precision can reduce roundoff but cannot make linearly dependent columns independent. Inspect rank or singular values.
